scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm run check:cloudflare:env && PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/zero3-pro run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.d1-staging.toml --outdir .wrangler/build
scripts.check:cloudflare:env: node -e 'if (!process.env.VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) { console.error("VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is required at build time"); process.exit(1); }'
scripts.check:cloudflare: pnpm run cf-typegen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:cloudflare
scripts.test:battery-time-cap: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec esbuild ../../scripts/tests/battery-time-cap.test.ts ../../artifacts/zero3-pro/src/lib/battery-time-display.test.ts ../../artifacts/zero3-pro/src/lib/event-battery-timer-controls.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=/tmp/zero3-battery-cap-tests --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test /tmp/zero3-battery-cap-tests/*.mjs && bash scripts/tests/test-d1-battery-time-cap.sh
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
